technical_quality: Adequate PA film: good inspiration (~9-10 posterior ribs), minimal rotation (medial clavicle ends roughly equidistant from spinous processes), adequate penetration (thoracic spine visible through the cardiac shadow), apices and both costophrenic angles included; scapulae partly project over the upper lateral lung fields.

devices.location: upper left of patient (image upper right), outside the thorax over the left shoulder

abnormalities.finding: Cardiac silhouette projects predominantly to the left of the spine with the right heart border largely hidden behind the vertebral column; no definite cardiomegaly (CTR roughly 0.5) - likely positional, mild leftward mediastinal shift not excluded
Left hilum appears relatively high compared with the right hilum without any associated upper-zone veil-like opacity or luftsichel sign - probably normal variant/positional, of uncertain significance

description_zh: PA 正面胸部X光，吸氣量足夠、旋轉輕微、穿透度適當，未見任何導管、引流管或植入裝置。兩側肺野大致清晰，未見明確的肺葉或節段性塌陷、肺門明顯移位或橫膈顯著上抬；經對比增強後，僅在心後區及左肺底見極輕微、不確定的密度增加，若確有肺擴張不全，最可能為左下肺野的輕微線狀或次節段性變化，但本片無法確認。心影略偏左、右心緣被脊椎遮蔽，可能為體位因素；左肺門位置相對右側稍高但無相關上肺野混濁；兩側肋膈角銳利，未見肋膜積液或氣胸。
